authoritative_sources.title: How Offshore Wind Can Benefit from Transferable Skills in Oil and Gas
authoritative_sources.research_use_and_limit: Identifies offshore operations, HSE, and project management as possible transferable skill areas. Practitioner/editorial source, not independent labor-market demand evidence.

authoritative_sources.research_use_and_limit: Describes training modules including first aid, working at height, manual handling, fire awareness, sea survival, and emergency evacuation/rescue. It does not show that every executive or wind-sector role needs the credential.
